text: The pipeline begins with an unconstrained two-dimensional facial image as input.
A trained convolutional neural network processes the image to jointly predict intermediate three-dimensional representations.
First, it predicts the Projected Normalized Coordinate Code, providing dense facial landmarks.
Simultaneously, the network estimates a corresponding three-dimensional offset map.
Combined, the dense landmarks and offsets directly reconstruct a full three-dimensional facial point cloud.
Alternatively, this predicted geometry serves as linear constraints to estimate three-dimensional Morphable Model coefficients.
